eps.t: My Absurd Skill Is Unexpectedly Useful
eps.ov: One day, Tsuyoshi Mukohda, an extremely ordinary salaryman, gets caught up in a hero summons being performed in another world. At the time of his summoning, he receives a unique skill known as "Online Grocery", that allows him to bring food ingredients and seasonings from his original world. Even though this skill seems plain at first glance, the food he brings into this new world has an absurd effect...!?
eps.ta: مهارتي العجيبة نافعة على غير توقع
eps.oa: ذات يوم يُستدعى «تسويوشي موكودا»، الموظف العادي جداً، من غير قصد في طقس استدعاء أبطال يجري في عالم آخر. وحين يُستدعى ينال مهارة فريدة تُعرف بـ«السوبرماركت الشبكي»، تتيح له أن يجلب مكونات الطعام والتوابل من عالمه الأصلي. ومع أن المهارة تبدو عادية في النظرة الأولى، فللطعام الذي يجلبه إلى هذا العالم الجديد أثر عجيب...!؟

eps.t: The Salient Familiar Is a Living Legend
eps.ov: After the legendary wolf monster Fenrir got attracted to the delicious smell of Mukohda's food and signed the Familiar Contract with him, Mukohda decides to register with the Guild in Fallières his next stop.
eps.oa: بعد أن اجتذبت رائحة طعام «موكودا» الشهية الذئب الوحش الأسطوري «فنرير» فعقد معه عقد التابع، يقرر موكودا أن يسجّل في النقابة في محطته التالية، «فالييه».

eps.t: My Super Power Is All About Cooking
eps.ov: After registering with both the Merchant's and the Adventurer's Guilds, Mukohda immediately decides to take on a beginner’s quest. However, when they deliver the monsters that Fel caught during their quest to the Guild, they find out that most of these monsters are B-rank or higher.
eps.oa: بعد أن يسجّل «موكودا» في نقابتي التجار والمغامرين، يقرر في الحال أن يأخذ مهمة للمبتدئين. لكن حين يسلّمون النقابة الوحوش التي صادها «فيل» في المهمة، يعرفون أن أكثرها من الدرجة B فما فوق.

eps.t: Cannot Start the Journey Without a Map
eps.ov: Mukohda asks Fel to teach him how to use magic after witnessing his wind magic. However, when things do not seem to go well, Fel decides to start a Spartan training regimen for him.
eps.oa: بعد أن يشهد «موكودا» سحر الريح لدى «فيل» يطلب منه أن يعلّمه استعمال السحر. لكن حين لا تجري الأمور على ما يرام يقرر فيل أن يُخضعه لتدريب إسبرطي صارم.

eps.t: The Goddess of Wind Has a Sweet Tooth
eps.ov: Mukohda and Fel arrive at a large lake, where they catch some fish and have their usual meal. But right when they start eating inside the barrier that keeps monsters at bay, a baby slime appears out of nowhere...?
eps.oa: يصل «موكودا» و«فيل» إلى بحيرة كبيرة فيصيدان سمكاً ويتناولان وجبتهما المعتادة. لكن ما إن يبدآ الأكل داخل الحاجز الذي يصد الوحوش حتى يظهر «سلايم» صغير من حيث لا يُدرى...؟

eps.ov: The place Fel decides to bring Mukohda to get some battle experience ends up being a creepy dungeon. Even so, Mukohda gets ready for battle and increases his stats by eating a meal from his original world using the “Online Grocery”. However...
eps.ta: النمو يأتي من حيث لا تحتسب
eps.oa: يتبين أن المكان الذي قرر «فيل» أن يأخذ إليه «موكودا» ليكسب خبرة قتالية متاهة مخيفة. ومع ذلك يستعد موكودا للمعركة ويرفع خصائصه بتناول وجبة من عالمه الأصلي جلبها بمهارة «السوبرماركت الشبكي». لكن...

eps.ov: Mukohda and his familiars dash through the forest, after strengthening their bonds in the dungeon. However, they soon find themselves in the territory of dangerous monsters and, just like Mukohda expected, surrounded by a pack of orthros...

eps.t: All of the Boss Monsters Are Tasty
eps.ov: After Mukohda rescues a traveling caravan from a band of bandits, they set out together for the great city of Karelina. But when Mukohda visits the Adventurer’s Guild in the city, he gets notified that his membership was revoked...?

eps.t: Hunting Quests Are All About Meat and Money
eps.ov: Mukohda gets summoned by the guild master after defeating an entire settlement of goblins while finishing a guild request. Although Mukohda didn't want to make a big deal out of it, he receives a high-ranking quest directly from the guild master...?

eps.t: My Two Familiars Are Too Overpowered
eps.ov: Mukohda and his familiars receive a request to head towards a mine and hunt down the metal lizard that inhabits it. Instead, they run into a rare mithril lizard. After Mukohda defeats the lizard, with the help of Fel and Sui, Fel turns his interest towards a different and tastier prey...?

Lambert consults Mukohda about a gift for his wife. When Mukohda suggests a certain product he purchased from the online grocery, it leads to an unexpected situation. Meanwhile, a pack of dangerous monsters, called wyverns, are approaching the town...?

eps.t: Adventures Are as Countless as Varieties of Food
eps.ov: After easily defeating the pack of dangerous yet powerful wyverns, Mukohda and his familiars receive praise not only from the guild, but also from the entire town. Unfazed by the attention, Mukohda goes out to look for a certain thing that he's always wanted to get in ever since he got summoned to this world.
